title: Service Fee Waiver Given against Nights of Property Facility Fee
content:
A service fee waiver is given on the closing folio balance of a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range according to the nights of property facility fee standing on the folio. Where the folio carries 8 or more, the service fee waiver is 14.95 USD. Where it carries 3 or more but fewer than 8, the service fee waiver is 7.50 USD. Where it carries fewer than 3, the service fee waiver is nil.

The number read here is a count of nights of the property facility fee standing on the folio, not their money total, and no other charge enters the count.

**Read as input, judgement and result, on hypothetical folios.**

> Input: 8 nights of property facility fee on the folio.
> Judgement: 8 is not fewer than 8.
> Result: 14.95 USD.

> Input: 7 nights of property facility fee on the folio.
> Judgement: fewer than 8 but not fewer than 3.
> Result: 7.50 USD.

> Input: 3 nights of property facility fee on the folio.
> Judgement: 3 is the foot of the middle band.
> Result: 7.50 USD.

> Input: 2 nights of property facility fee on the folio.
> Judgement: fewer than 3.
> Result: Nil.

> Input: 2 nights of property facility fee and 9 nights of parking on the folio.
> Judgement: parking does not enter the count, so the property facility fee stands at 2 nights.
> Result: Nil.
